about.title: About Airports API
about.description: Airports is a full-stack Go web application providing comprehensive global airport information. It serves data on 35,000+ airports worldwide — ICAO/IATA codes, names, city, country, coordinates, elevation, and type — through a versioned REST API, a GraphQL endpoint, and a server-side rendered web UI.

help.title: Help & API Reference
help.intro: Airports provides a public, read-only REST and GraphQL API. Airport data and public server information need no authentication; metrics use per-service bearer tokens.
help.ep_single_desc: Single airport by ICAO or IATA code
help.ep_search_desc: Search by name, city, country, or code
help.ep_countries_desc: List of countries with airport counts
help.ep_geoip_ip_desc: GeoIP lookup for a specific IP
help.aliases_desc: For client convenience, these unversioned aliases are mounted to the same handlers as the current API version:
help.faq_q1: Do I need an API key?
help.faq_a1: No. Airport data and public information are open; only metrics endpoints require service-specific bearer tokens.
help.faq_q2: Where does the data come from?
help.faq_a2: OurAirports public-domain dataset, embedded into the binary at build time.
help.faq_a3: Airport data is refreshed each release. GeoIP databases auto-update weekly.
help.mcp_desc: Connect an MCP client to Airport data tools.
help.mcp_overview_desc: Airports exposes its public, read-only API operations as Model Context Protocol tools.
help.mcp_endpoint_desc: Configure an MCP client to use this streamable HTTP endpoint.
help.mcp_auth_desc: Every MCP request requires Authorization: Bearer with a linked owner token created for that client. Never use the primary owner token or the operator token (server.token). The public REST API does not require a token.
help.mcp_connect_desc: Add this server URL to an MCP client that supports streamable HTTP.
help.mcp_tools_caption: Tools currently exposed by the API router.
help.mcp_limits_desc: MCP accepts POST only, keeps no sessions, validates browser Origin values, and uses the API rate limits and audit trail. A request must use protocol revision 2026-07-28 and the required matching MCP headers.
help.mcp_troubleshooting_origin: Check that the client can reach the endpoint and that the Origin header is allowed.
help.mcp_troubleshooting_version: Use one of the protocol versions listed above.
help.mcp_troubleshooting_transport: Use an MCP client that supports streamable HTTP and JSON-RPC 2.0.
help.mcp_project_desc: Ask an assistant to find airports near a location, search by airport or city name, compare airport details, or list airports by country. The tools return the same public airport data as the REST API.
help.mcp_status_202: A notification was accepted without a response body.
help.mcp_status_400: The request or protocol metadata is invalid.
help.mcp_status_401: The bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired.
help.mcp_status_403: The request Origin is not allowed.
help.mcp_status_405: The HTTP method is not supported.
help.tor_intro: This service is available through the Tor network.
help.tor_connect_help: Open the address in the Tor Browser. The service uses HTTP inside the Tor network.
help.i2p_intro: This service is available through the I2P network.
help.i2p_connect_help: Open the address in an I2P-enabled browser or proxy.
help.troubleshooting_rate_limit: Wait for the rate-limit window to reset before retrying. Reduce request frequency for automated clients.
help.troubleshooting_nearby: Check that latitude and longitude are within valid ranges and increase the search radius.
help.troubleshooting_map: Airport coordinates and OpenStreetMap links remain available when map tiles or JavaScript are unavailable.
help.mcp_issue_400: The protocol version or a required header does not match.
help.mcp_fix_400: Use a supported MCP-Protocol-Version and send the required MCP headers.
help.mcp_issue_401: The bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired.
help.mcp_fix_401: Use a linked token and send it as Authorization: Bearer $MCP_TOKEN. The response includes WWW-Authenticate: Bearer.
help.mcp_issue_403: The Origin is not allowed or the token cannot access the requested operation.
help.mcp_fix_403: Use an allowed Origin and a linked token with access to the operation.
help.mcp_issue_405: The request used an unsupported HTTP method.
help.mcp_fix_405: Send MCP requests with POST; GET and DELETE are not supported.
help.features_desc: Look up airports by ICAO or IATA code, search by airport or city name, or find nearby airports by coordinates and radius. Results provide coordinates and OpenStreetMap links; interactive maps add markers when JavaScript and map tiles are available.
help.feature_maps: Airport and search results include coordinates and OpenStreetMap links; interactive maps are available when JavaScript and map tiles load.
help.faq_a4: Miles by default. Pass {parameter} for kilometers.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: The Airports API is a public, read-only reference service with no user accounts. Optional analytics run only with consent.
privacy.collect_logs_desc: standard HTTP access logs (timestamp, method, path, status, response size, user agent) retained only as long as the operator's log rotation policy dictates.
privacy.collect_geoip_desc: used at request time only to surface nearby airports on the home page. The IP is never persisted, never logged in association with results, and never shared with third parties.
privacy.not_collect_accounts: No user accounts, no email addresses, no profile data.
privacy.not_collect_analytics: No third-party analytics, no ad networks, no tag managers.
privacy.third_party_desc: GeoIP databases are downloaded from public CDNs at server startup and refreshed weekly. No request data is sent to any third party at runtime.
privacy.api_cookie_essential_desc: Theme preference (dark/light/auto) stored in localStorage only. No server-side session cookies.

privacy.analytics_not_sold: Analytics data is anonymized and never sold.
privacy.analytics_sold: Analytics data may be shared with third parties.
privacy.retention_default: Airports has no user accounts or profiles. Rate-limit records are retained for their configured window and expired records are removed. Request logs follow configured rotation and retention. Analytics retention is controlled by the configured provider.
privacy.data_usage_default:
**Airports uses information processed to:**

- **Provide airport data:** Serve search, geographic queries, and airport information.
- **Protect the service:** Apply rate limits and detect abuse using hashed client-IP identifiers.
- **Operate the service:** Use request logs only when logging is configured and retain them according to policy.
- **Improve the experience:** Send analytics only when a provider is configured and consent permits it.

Airports has no user accounts or profiles, so it does not provide account data export or account deletion controls.
privacy.data_usage_sold:
**Airports uses information processed to:**

- **Provide airport data:** Serve search, geographic queries, and airport information.
- **Protect the service:** Apply rate limits and detect abuse using hashed client-IP identifiers.
- **Operate the service:** Use request logs only when logging is configured and retain them according to policy.
- **Improve the experience:** Send analytics only when a provider is configured and consent permits it.

When the configured sold-data option is enabled, the operator may share or sell data as described in the sharing conditions. You can opt out using the control below.
privacy.data_security_default:
**How we protect data:**

- Rate-limit storage uses hashed client-IP identifiers.
- Request-log retention and rotation follow server configuration.
- HTTPS/TLS is used when enabled by the server operator.
privacy.sharing_analytics: Analytics is shared only when a provider is configured and the visitor consents; data may include anonymized page views, browser type, and country.
privacy.sharing_email: Email is shared when SMTP is configured; the data may include the sender’s email address and message content.
privacy.sharing_user_initiated: User-initiated sharing occurs only when a visitor chooses to share content, such as an export; the visitor selects what to share.
privacy.sharing_analytics_when: Only when analytics is configured and the visitor consents.
privacy.sharing_analytics_data: Anonymized page views, browser type, and country.
